evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!A6:D6 prohibits exposing the judge, rubric, dimensions, weights, test paths or sentinels; Internal Quality Checks!A6:Z6 adds no row-specific annotation. Frozen instruction.md:1-5 and all six frozen environment/instructions/*.md were read. A case-insensitive search for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|gate|probe returned no matches in those seven public files. The public /api/health at integration.md:3 and named editor libraries at ui.md:3 are product/runtime requirements, not test paths or grader machinery. Comparing tokenized public text against all 31 descriptions in the five frozen judge.toml files found no 12-word overlap except the 14-word list of prohibited ready-made editors shared by ui.md:3 and tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23; that list is the actual public editor constraint and reveals no hidden probe or score. No criterion id or distinctive judge-created value appears in the public files. A broken static app gains no hidden grading instructions from the prompt; an otherwise conforming implementation using its own editor is not singled out by a hidden sentinel. SHA-256 of instruction.md, all six public notes, constraints judge.toml, the workbook and skill matches their manifest.json input hashes. This is a source-level review; no runtime run was needed for this row.
